title: UserData
description: User identification data for matching conversion events to Snapchat users. All personally identifiable information should be hashed using SHA-256 before sending.

em.description: SHA-256 hashed lowercase email address of the user.

ph.description: SHA-256 hashed phone number in E.164 format.

fn.description: SHA-256 hashed lowercase first name of the user.

ln.description: SHA-256 hashed lowercase last name of the user.

db.description: SHA-256 hashed date of birth in YYYYMMDD format.

st.description: SHA-256 hashed lowercase two-letter state code.

country.description: SHA-256 hashed lowercase two-letter country code.

external_id.description: SHA-256 hashed external ID for the user.

client_ip_address.description: The IP address of the user's browser or device.

client_user_agent.description: The user agent string of the user's browser.

sc_click_id.description: The Snapchat click ID from the ad click URL parameter.
